title: Children's Museum of Phoenix

services.name: Exhibits & Experiences
services.desc: The Museum’s exhibits are thoughtfully designed to be unique, to arouse curiosity, and to engage the minds, muscles and imaginations of our visitors. We provide open-ended, imaginative play to all of our guests. Let your child be the guide and enjoy the journey because the learning will be meaningful and the memories delightful at one of the best places to take kids in Phoenix. Before planning your visit, check the Children’s Museum of Phoenix hours to make the most of your family’s experience. In this creative workshop, visitors find an ever-changing array of hands-on art activities that help them make connections to the real world as well as to other exhibits in the Museum. Art Studio

blurb: Discover hands-on exhibits, joyful learning, and meaningful moments designed for curious minds and growing families. From interactive play zones to engaging programs, every visit encourages creativity, problem-solving, and social connection. Seasonal events, camps, and celebrations give kids new ways to explore while parents enjoy a welcoming, accessible space.
